tool_args.rationale: The pilot horizons are at most 0.48, far below the target horizon of 22.2. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish sustained gain from the recalled long-horizon reversal before fitting a forecast model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a dual-horizon adaptation model to the pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow response needed for H = 22.2.
Additional short-window resolution is less direct than long-horizon measurements for resolving the slow response.
The short pilot does not distinguish these alternatives sufficiently from a slow adaptation mechanism.
